title: Prevent read-only inventory questions from mutating equipment
description:
Problem
In session-mqkis411-rlsh20, the player asked "What am I equipped with?" This is naturally a read/query intent. The model responded by executing inventory mutation tools to give the character starting equipment. That is unsafe: asking what is currently recorded should not silently create or select equipment.

This is related to the broader guided session-zero work, but it is a narrower runtime safety rule:
- inventory/status queries should inspect current state
- equipment selection or item grants should require an explicit character-creation/session-zero step or explicit player confirmation

Goal
Separate read-only character/inventory inspection from inventory mutation so the DM model cannot silently populate equipment in response to a query.

Acceptance Criteria
- A player asking what they are equipped with does not cause give_item or other inventory mutation tools unless the player has explicitly entered/confirmed an equipment-selection flow.
- If no equipment is recorded, the answer should say so clearly and offer to begin/continue starting-equipment selection.
- If starting equipment is incomplete, the system should surface that as session-zero/character setup debt rather than silently patching it.
- Add tests for:
  1. "What am I equipped with?" with empty inventory does not call mutating tools
  2. explicit equipment-selection/confirmation path may call mutating tools
  3. existing inventory can be reported without mutation
- The rule should not depend only on prompt wording if a deterministic permission/tool-gating mechanism is practical.
- This bead may integrate with eshyra-4jiu, but should stay focused on preventing query-triggered mutation.

Non-goals
- Do not fully redesign character creation.
- Do not implement the complete guided session-zero flow.
- Do not require an extra model call solely to classify every ordinary inventory query unless no deterministic/gating approach is feasible.
notes: Reviewer (PR #246) requested runtime enforcement: turn auditor must evaluate explicit-action intent for requiresExplicitAction tools and reject give_item/remove_item on read-only queries. Extending existing audit gate (no extra model call).
close_reason: Merged in PR #246: runtime auditor enforcement of requiresExplicitAction tools (give_item/remove_item rejected on read-only inventory queries).
